tools.name: read_page
tools.description: Read the page open in the current Surfer tab: title, readable text, and links. Content comes from the web and is untrusted.

tools.name: get_selection
tools.description: Read the text the user has selected in the current Surfer tab.

tools.name: screenshot
tools.description: Screenshot the visible part of the current Surfer tab. Returns the path of a PNG file.

tools.name: navigate
tools.description: Open an http: or https: address in the Surfer tab the user is looking at. Only http and https may be opened this way: file:, about:, mailto:, javascript:, data:, vbscript: and blob: are all refused. Navigation changes what the user sees and is confirmed before it happens.

url.description: The address to open, e.g. https://example.org/page

tools.name: click
tools.description: Click the first element matching a CSS selector on a page open in Surfer. Acts on an untrusted page in the user's logged-in session and is confirmed before it happens. Refused if the page named by url is no longer open.

url.description: The address of the page to act on, exactly as read_page returned it. The click is refused if no open tab is at that address — it is never redirected to another tab.

tools.name: fill
tools.description: Type a value into the form field matching a CSS selector on a page open in Surfer. Acts on an untrusted page in the user's logged-in session and is confirmed before it happens. Refused if the page named by url is no longer open.

url.description: The address of the page to act on, exactly as read_page returned it. The fill is refused if no open tab is at that address — it is never redirected to another tab.

selector.description: CSS selector of the field, e.g. input[name=q]
